title_vi: Event sourcing khác thiết kế CRUD ở đâu: lưu trạng thái hay lưu chuyện đã xảy ra

related.reason_vi: Event sourcing là một trong sáu mẫu quản lý dữ liệu.
Khóa chính trên số thứ tự sự kiện là một dạng khóa lạc quan.
Thu thay đổi dữ liệu biến thay đổi của bảng CRUD thành luồng sự kiện.

claims.claim_vi: Event sourcing records each event in an append-only store and derives current state by replaying the entity's event stream; the only way to undo a change is a compensating event; materialized views and projections are eventually consistent; events need versioning; snapshots reduce replay cost; it is a complex pattern costly to migrate to or from and not suited to systems that need real-time consistent views or teams new to event-driven design.
claims.section: Solution; Problems and considerations; When to use this pattern
claims.verified_by: Read from a partial clone of MicrosoftDocs/architecture-center at commit 8e2c239344ee753a88856800b4210a3e27ac1036.

claims.claim_vi: Measured on PostgreSQL 16.15: after placed, paid, refunded and cancelled, the CRUD row held cancelled, 500, 10:21; the event table held four events; replaying to 10:05 gave paid with 500 paid, to 10:30 cancelled with 0; a second insert of sequence 5 failed with 'duplicate key value violates unique constraint'.
claims.verified_by: Author's own run on 2026-10-18 with two minimal tables, not a dedicated event store.

claims.claim_vi: The source compares a CRUD design with an event sourcing design for an e-commerce system that places and pays for orders, and says event sourcing is used to design a system with determinism.
claims.verified_by: Source body read; it is three short paragraphs and the comparison itself is in the source image, which was not opened.

design_notes_vi: Hai luồng bốn bước cho cùng một đơn hàng, một theo CRUD, một theo event sourcing, và ba điều đo được. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
